title: feat(types): TypeScript node types for the authored properties-bag carriers (flex and the eight object-* blocks), by reference, joined into AuthoringNode (objectui#11468)
body:
Fixes #11468

Clause-②: yes

F3 of objectui#8347 (that card stays open and waits on this one and its two siblings). Dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) and implemented by an os-dev subagent of session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`. Generic parameters below are spelled in words (for example "a record of string to never"), because GitHub strips tag-shaped text from a body.

## What changes on the published face

`@object-ui/types` adds ten exported types. Each is derived by reference from its zod arm, and none is restated:

| export | what it is |
| --- | --- |
| `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode` | one member per arm of `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`, each the arm's own input: the derivation `PublicBlockNode` uses |
| `ObjectMetricBlockNode`, `ObjectMasterDetailFormBlockNode`, `ObjectTimelineBlockNode`, `ObjectFormBlockNode`, `ObjectMapBlockNode`, `ObjectChartBlockNode`, `ObjectGanttBlockNode`, `ObjectGridBlockNode` | the member of `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode` for each `type` |
| `FlexBlockNode` | the `FlexBlockSchema` arm's input |

`AuthoringNode` gains two members: it is now `PublicBlockNode | ObjectQLPublicBlockNode | FlexBlockNode | ElementTextInputNode | ElementRecordPickerNode | PageDocumentNode`. The type expression of `SchemaRenderer`'s `schema` prop does not change (`BaseSchema | AuthoringNode | string | null | undefined`), and the prop accepts the nine carriers through `AuthoringNode`. No zod schema, renderer or runtime code changes.

### Accept set, before and after (TypeScript face only)

- **Before:** an authored `object-map`, `object-grid` or other carrier node, or a `flex` node, had no TypeScript type. The docs annotated it `BaseSchema`, whose index signature accepts any key, so a misspelled bag key compiled.
- **After:** the node type is the arm's own input. It refuses a misspelled bag key, a bag member written flat on the node, and a node-level `children` or `body`, as the zod arm and the strict authoring face do.

### The one derivation change: the bag is read closed, like the arm

`ClosedArmInput` read an arm's shape with the object config left closed, but it read the `properties` member as it stood. `flex` and `object-chart` have no `ComponentPropsMap` row. Their bags are the flat mirrors' own members (`FlexPropsBag`, `ObjectChartPropsBag`), kept `.passthrough()` for the tolerant face (objectui#11276). So the shape-only read left each of those bags with an index signature of unknown, and a misspelled bag key compiled. The derivation now reads the bag's shape too (`ClosedBag`), so the TypeScript face is closed where the strict authoring face closes it.

A spec-row bag is already closed. `PublicBlockNode` is unchanged, and an exact type equality pins that. Measured: among the nine carrier arms, the shape-only read leaves exactly two bags open (`flex` and `object-chart`). Among the 27 public blocks it leaves none (the `element:divider` bag is a record of string to never, which refuses every key).

## Pins

All in `packages/types/src/__tests__/authoring-nodes-bag-carriers-11468.test.ts`. The type-level assertions are judged by the package's `type-check` test leg:

1. No arm is lost: the derived `type` sets equal the arms' own, for the eight-arm union and for `flex`.
2. Each named alias is its arm. The carrier members of `AuthoringNode` are exactly `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode | FlexBlockNode`.
3. No `AuthoringNode` member has an open bag. The control: the shape-only derivation leaves exactly `object-chart` and `flex` open.
4. `PublicBlockNode` equals the shape-only derivation, so closing the bag changes nothing for a spec row.

The behaviour checks use the 11364 pin file's method: `BaseSchema`'s index signature is stripped at the type level, so they run now and after the removal.
- `object-map`: the spelled bag compiles. A misspelled bag key and a flat prop are refused.
- `flex`: the bag is closed. A flat prop, a node-level `children` and `body` are refused. An inline literal compiles at the prop.
- `object-chart`: the bag is closed.
- A runtime check that every carrier arm and both mirror bags are zod objects (the derivation's premises).

### Ablations (run once and restored, not kept as tests)

Each ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode against the committed head, with the two authoring-nodes pin files compiled by tsc:
- **Bag closure removed** (the `properties` member read as the arm declares it): 3 errors. The no-open-bag assertion fails with TS2344, and the closed-bag `@ts-expect-error` directives in the flex and object-chart cases become unused (TS2578). The `PublicBlockNode` equality stays green, as predicted.
- **The two members removed from `AuthoringNode`**: 3 errors. The join assertion fails with TS2344, and both inline literals (object-map and flex) are refused at the post-removal prop with TS2353 on `properties`.

The restore was proven each time: the blob equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The first attempt of each was refused by the tool before it measured anything, because the replacement text was a substring of the anchor. Each was restored and re-run with a distinct replacement.

An earlier fifth type-level assertion ("every carrier fits the post-removal prop") still passed with the join removed, because a typed constant fits `BaseSchema` structurally either way. The flex inline literal replaced it, and that literal does discriminate.

## The doc corpus, re-judged under the P1 mutation

The P1 mutation deletes `BaseSchema`'s index signature and its docblock (wrap mode, restored afterwards) and rebuilds `@object-ui/types`. The dist then carries 1 signature, on `ComponentRendererProps`. The readings are from `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types` and the types examples' tsc.

| reading | doc-snippets, mutated | F3 diagnostics | types examples tsc, mutated |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| base `d93e53f5`, all at base | 70 of 776 blocks failed, 75 diagnostics | 46 | 3 errors |
| head, node types plus re-annotations | 30 of 776 failed, 33 diagnostics | 5 (H3 below) | 1 error (the F1 header-bar cast) |

The base column matches the parent's P1 census (46 F3 diagnostics in 75).
- **Removed:** 41 F3 diagnostics and 1 F1 diagnostic (the types README `crumbs`, explained under "flex child list"). The 41 are 39 re-annotated blocks plus 2 inline `SchemaRenderer` `object-grid` literals in objectos-integration.mdx, which compile through `AuthoringNode` with no edit.
- **Added:** none.

Without the mutation, at head: `check:doc-snippets` judged 776 of 776 blocks with 0 failed, and `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-types` exit 0.

Every document re-judged:
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx`: 7 blocks re-annotated as `ObjectMapBlockNode`. 5 keep `BaseSchema` (H3).
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx`: 10 blocks, `ObjectGanttBlockNode`.
- `packages/plugin-grid/README.md`: 11 blocks, `ObjectGridBlockNode`. Their `satisfies ObjectGridProps` bag checks are kept.
- `packages/plugin-form/README.md`: 2 blocks, `ObjectFormBlockNode`.
- `packages/plugin-map/README.md`: 2 blocks, `ObjectMapBlockNode`.
- `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md`: 1 block, `ObjectGanttBlockNode`.
- `content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx`: 1 block, `ObjectGridBlockNode`. Its 2 inline literals needed no edit.
- `content/docs/utilities/index.md` and `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx`: 1 block each, `ObjectGridBlockNode`.
- Root `README.md`: 1 block, `ObjectFormBlockNode`.
- `packages/types/README.md`: the nested flex block is `FlexBlockNode`, and its two `satisfies FlexLayoutProps` bag checks are replaced ("flex child list" below). "Authoring the spec's blocks in TypeScript" lists the new types.
- `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts`: both flex nodes are `FlexBlockNode` (the outer one annotated, the inner one with `satisfies`).

### H3: five plugin-map.mdx blocks author a key the arm refuses

The blocks are `clickableMap`, `storeLocator`, `deliveryMap`, `propertyMap` and `serviceMap`. Each writes `onMarkerClick` (a function) on the node, beside the bag. The page teaches "a schema built in code carries it on the node, beside the bag".
- No contract declares the key: not `ObjectMapBlockSchema`, not the TS twin `ObjectMapSchema`. The strict face refuses it as an unrecognized key.
- Annotated `ObjectMapBlockNode`, each block failed `check:doc-snippets` with TS2353 on `onMarkerClick` (measured). The type was not widened.
- So these five keep `BaseSchema`. They compile while the signature exists, and under the mutation each still fails (on `properties`, the first excess key TypeScript reports).
- This is the handler-key class that objectui#8347's last PR already carries for plugin-calendar.mdx (`onEventClick`, `onDateClick`). The P1 census did not see these five, because TypeScript reported `properties` first.
- Each block's bag already type-checks as `ObjectMapBlockNode`, so the annotation can move once the handler key has a disposition.

### flex child list

`FlexBlockSchema` declares `properties.children` as a list of unknown, because the page walk judges each entry. The node type carries that by reference, so `FlexBlockNode` does not check a child written inline in a flex bag. The types README and the dashboard example name each inline child's type with `satisfies` (`FlexBlockNode`, `HeaderBarSchema`). That is also what removes the types README `crumbs` diagnostic that P1 classed as F1: the header-bar child is now checked against `HeaderBarSchema`, which declares `crumbs`. Nothing is widened or narrowed.

## Gates, all at head `333f5a89` unless named

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (src, examples and tests): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react run type-check` (the reader of `AuthoringNode` through `SchemaRendererProps`): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/`, from the worktree root: 331 files and 8766 tests passed. The two authoring-nodes pin files run by name: 2 files and 11 tests passed.
- `check:doc-snippets` (776 of 776 judged, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-types`: exit 0, after a rebuild of `@object-ui/types` at head.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence` (1 package, 1 changeset), `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: exit 0.
- `check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It names 12 pending changesets that cite a file this change touches. I read each paragraph, and none is falsified (the edits change annotations only).
- Targeted eslint: the package's own `eslint` on the 4 changed TS files gives 0 errors and 0 warnings. The repository lint run is CI's.
- Not run: `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`, because no registration input moved. Other packages' vitest was not run, because no runtime code changed.

## Overlap with in-flight work

- objectui#11466 (F1) also edits `packages/types/src/index.ts` (read uncommitted in its worktree). Whichever lands second merges `main`. F1's slot union includes `AuthoringNode`, so the nine carriers flow into it.
- objectui#11467 (F2) shares no file with this change.

## Acceptance notes

- The flex bag's child list is a list of unknown on the TypeScript face, by reference to the arm. A nested node written inline there is unchecked unless the author names its type. This is recorded for objectui#11466's slot typing and is not changed here.
- Toolchain: the container's Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom 30's engine floor, so every command ran with a SHA256-verified nodejs.org v22.23.3 tarball on PATH from this issue's scratch directory. Nothing system-wide changed.
